fusions.name: Stifling Word
fusions.desc: Fires a muffling word that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Stalled] for 8 seconds, its abilities coming back slower. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Silent Script
fusions.desc: A ring of silencing script that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring resistances, and leaves each [Muddled] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Cast
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 40% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Corrected Spelling
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and your arcane resistance rises by 8%.
